column1: # selftest-slow-suites.tsv — suites tools/run-selftests.sh DEFERS TO CI by default (#566).
# WHAT THIS BUYS. lean-gate.sh milestone 3 runs the sweep as a single blocking call inside the
# harness turn, which reaps at roughly 120s. Before #566 the lane paid for that with a detached
# runner, a marker/rejoin protocol, INTERRUPTED_BUDGET_M3 and a lane registry — ~1,300 lines of
# supervision, guards included, whose only job was surviving a bound this table stays under.
# THE BOUND IS NOT COSMETIC. With nothing detached, a reaped milestone-3 call leaves an unclosed
# `started` row and loses its work; five of those exhaust the interrupted budget and hard-stop the
# run at rc=4. An unbounded sweep would make milestone 3 UNPASSABLE in an autonomous lane, not
# merely slow. The pass cache does not rescue it either — it is opt-in per suite via
# tools/selftest-cache-inputs.tsv, and a measured warm re-run of this sweep served 1 of 66.
# APPLIED BY DEFAULT; `--full` opts out, and every sweep of record passes it: both CI selftest
# jobs, both nightly wholesale lanes, and the CLAUDE.md contributor recipe. A row here narrows
# the LOCAL pre-PR check ONLY. Nothing listed stops being a merge requirement — CI still sweeps
# everything and the merge boundary still blocks on CI — so a row costs signal latency, never
# soundness.
# THE MEMBERSHIP RULE IS A MEASUREMENT, NOT A JUDGMENT: every suite in this tree was timed alone
# on 2026-08-20 (67 suites, 603s serial), and every suite at or above 9s is listed. That leaves
# 98s serial with a longest single suite of 8s, which is what makes the bound reachable. The
# threshold is the whole rule — do not hand-pick around it, and re-measure when you change what a
# listed suite does.
# THIS IS A LOT OF DEFERRAL, and it should be read as a finding rather than a detail: on this tree
# twelve suites carry 84% of the sweep's cost, and they are disproportionately the LANE'S OWN
# guards. Their regressions now surface at PR CI instead of before the push. The durable fix is to
# widen tools/selftest-cache-inputs.tsv so a re-run is cheap, which shrinks this table by making
# repeat sweeps free; that is separate work and is deliberately not attempted here.
# A row naming no discovered suite is a HARD ERROR — the same stale-row posture --exclude,
# install-topology-known-red.tsv and mutation-baseline.tsv already carry. A suite ABSENT from
# this file is treated as fast.
# selftest<TAB>seconds<TAB>reason
tools/install-topology-selftest.sh
column3: re-runs every shipped suite from a staged install cache, so it costs the whole suite set twice; 319/438/584s over three runs. Already nightly-only in CI, so this row aligns the local check with a deferral CI had made.
